snippet.title: Official Trailer | Fabulous - Angela's High School Reunion
snippet.description:
Get ready for a High School Reunion like never before! Or ever again…
▶︎▶︎▶︎ Play now: http://m.onelink.me/7716b68d

Working on a new line of prom dresses, Angela starts reminiscing about her prom, which was a total catastrophe. To make up for this, she decides to organize a class reunion! But when her high school rival suddenly shows up, things soon take a turn for the worst... 

Can Angela prove she’s learned from her past? Or will everything get out of control?
